summary: Polibeli Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Zhitian Zhang eff. May 15, 2026 for personal reasons (no disagreements). The Board initially appointed CEO Hua Chen as interim principal financial officer, then on June 8, 2026 appointed Ms. Meijun Liang as permanent CFO (eff. immediately). Ms. Liang had been Financial Controller since Feb 2026, and previously served as Regional Finance Director at the controlling shareholder Xingyun. The departure is voluntary and non-disruptive. What to watch: whether a routine succession or signals deeper governance shift given Qin's prior role at the parent.
